title: Price reversible shared odd division for canonical Clifford readouts
body:
This supplies the terminal division step for Clifford readouts whose Gaussian numerator and shared denominator are already available. It implements quotient and remainder, nearest-even binary output, and restoration of the modulus on a reversible nearest-neighbour tape. The proofs price gates, storage, and head movement and determine the exact streaming state or latency under the stated one-pass interfaces.

The common denominators of the width-13 kernels split into an odd divisor and a binary shift. The canonical inverse uses the 145-bit odd integer from #7805. The 51-step pair uses $470624175\cdot2^{11352}$ and the 52-step pair uses $2^{7499}$. The schedule keeps the dyadic suffix outside the odd-division loop. The package also reconstructs the width-15, 16, 18, 20 and 22 five-qubit divisors.

For the identity-class coefficient of the actual width-13 inverse kernel, the circuit produces the nearest grid value $4580344441/2^{32}$. In the documented eight-track layout this takes **326 sites, 311,724 head moves**, 209,200 NOT gates, 260,239 CNOTs and 365,064 Toffolis. The registered checks include 57,344 forward and reverse sample cases and 3,348 independently generated prefix-depth checks. The application is terminal conversion of supplied numerators; numerator generation and complete multiplier integration remain open.

The arithmetic inputs come from #7805, #7809, #7812, #7816 and #7817, with the original Clifford sector and character dependencies credited in the package. The selected conditional exponent remains 0.00363005817.

All 6 registered CPython 3.12 checks passed in the checkout and in a read-only, Git-free export of the submitted commit. The source-history, committed-byte, mode and export-inventory checks passed.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/clifford-shared-denominator-tape
```

Prepared by apoursh with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. [Submitted proof](https://github.com/apoursh/integer-mult-bounds/blob/20a5532ea99b8ade78755486a6b92aa8071dc076/research/clifford-shared-denominator-tape/PROOF.md) · [Public research claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19756931)

**Hosted workflow.** The shared onboarding test failed before package selection. Its CI guide names #6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. I reproduced the same failure on the unchanged upstream files. All registered package checks passed locally and on the exported commit.
